en: Old sepia postcard showing a large multi‑storey brick industrial building beside a river with a low waterfall or rapids in the foreground. Trees and a few smaller factory buildings with chimneys stand on the riverbank. The lower margin and right edge are filled with handwritten cursive text. Faint printed captions appear along the bottom, partly readable in different languages.
